summary: Three Atlantic City churches; all weekday and evening Masses are at Our Lady Star of the Sea. The schedule box, intentions and website agree across both November bulletins; confessions run 30 to 10 minutes before each Mon-Sat evening Mass. Open: whether the Saturday 4:15 PM vigil counts as an evening Mass for confession. The Mercy Adoration Chapel at Cappella Studio is excluded and listed as a church-list issue (no address).
